chunks.prompt: A green light glows in the mist over dark water, its beam cutting through the haze as snow begins to fall, illuminating the rippling surface below. (Atmospheric music.)

Nick Carraway, dark-haired and in a pinstripe suit over a white shirt and vest, sits in a dim room, hand on forehead, looking distressed. He looks out the window. (Silence.)
Flashback montage: crowds in rain, stock market graph rising, dancers in yellow dresses, bottles being filled. (Fast paced music.)

Daisy Buchanan, her blonde bob framing her face, rests her head on her hand, the ring glinting on her finger, her expression pensive and distressed as Nick Carraway watches. (Soft music.)
